title: The Third Path
next_chapter_hook: "Just as Chen Ji was deciding on his course of action, the fourth page of the Tianji Record suddenly manifested: 'The way of the bridge begins beneath your feet—the first step, rescue your guide.' The location where Su Qingyao was trapped pointed directly to a forbidden land he had never dared set foot in—the Heavenly Dao Ruins."

text.content: "The aftermath of the Xuanwu Sect Master's狼狈 retreat had not yet subsided before the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate was shrouded in an eerie silence. Chen Ji stood alone atop the Main Peak, his robes fluttering violently in the mountain wind, while the talisman in his grasp burned scalding hot. Mo Xiansheng's voice still echoed in his ears, each word like a dull blade cutting flesh: 'Su Qingyao has been kidnapped by a mysterious force, her whereabouts unknown. The aura lingering on those forces bears an uncanny resemblance to Chen Nian.'"

dialogue.content: "'Young master, this matter is far from simple.' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted out from the first page of the Tianji Record, a rare gravity etched upon his aged features. 'After repeated divinations, this old servant has discovered two distinct Dao rhythms interwoven in the kidnapper's aura—one, the residual will of the Heavenly Eye; the other... the lost orthodox inheritance of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji closed his eyes, rapidly piecing together all the fragmented clues from recent days in his mind. His mother's arrangement, the truth behind the shackles, Tianqing's sacrifice—these seemingly unrelated clues now aligned as if guided by an invisible hand, gradually converging into a clear thread. His eyes snapped open, a gleam of brilliance piercing his pupils: 'I understand now. They don't want to kill Su Qingyao—they want to use her as bait.'"

dialogue.content: "'They're not fishing for the Tianqing Sect, nor for the Demonic Path—' Chen Ji's lips curved into a frigid arc, his voice terrifyingly calm. 'They're fishing for me. Chen Nian's residual aura was meant to trigger resonance with the Tianji Record; the traces of the Heavenly Eye were meant to make me think this was the ultimate chess game. And the one who truly set this trap...' He paused, a turbulent fury surging in his eyes. 'Wants to seize control of the Tianji Record the moment I step into the trap.'"

text.content: "At this moment, the Tianji Record itself shuddered violently, and an unprecedented golden light burst forth from the depths of the fragment, forcing Chen Ji to squint. The light coalesced into words, slowly manifesting in the void: 'The binary shackles are neither broken nor established—they are a bridge. The key opens the lock, and when the lock is destroyed, the key becomes worthless; a bridge connects, and both ends live. This is the third path—not the duty of a key, not a slave to Heaven, but the sole hub connecting Heaven and humanity.'"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji stared at the golden words, his breath involuntarily growing ragged. Mo Xiansheng was right—he had been contemplating how to break the shackles, how to oppose Heavenly Dao, but never once considered a third path. Key and lock are opposites, Heaven and humanity too are opposites—and if he could become the bridge connecting the two... 'So that's how it is.' He let out a low laugh, the sound carrying both the exhilaration of sudden understanding and a hint of near-madness. 'This is what Mother truly left me as her legacy.'"

choice.prompt: "The moment the Tianji Record manifested, Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate Value fluctuate violently within his body. Mo Xiansheng proposed two plans: first, to directly track Su Qingyao's trail and rescue her with the utmost speed; second, to first consolidate the foundation of the 'Bridge Way,' ensuring every subsequent step is foolproof. What will you choose?"

choices.description: "Su Qingyao's life hangs by a thread; every moment of delay increases her danger. Track and rescue immediately while the enemy is not fully prepared, demonstrating responsibility."
choices.risk_hint: "The enemy surely has backup plans; rushing in blindly may lead to being surrounded"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not hesitate in the slightest, his form darting forward like a stream of light, racing toward the direction Mo Xiansheng had indicated. The wind howled past his ears, but only one thought burned in his mind: Su Qingyao, wait for me. This time, he was no longer the chess master calculating every move, but a rescuer who had to outrun time itself."

dialogue.content: "'Su Qingyao is the only person I trust within the Tianqing Sect.' Chen Ji's voice was cold and resolute. 'If I cannot even protect those beside me, what use is talking about the third path?' Mo Xiansheng tried to speak but held back, ultimately letting out a sigh, allowing Chen Ji to make his choice."

choices.description: "A well-honed axe cuts better; first comprehend the Tianji Record's guidance, consolidate the foundation of the 'Bridge Way,' then act, ensuring every step lies beyond the enemy's calculations."
choices.risk_hint: "May miss the optimal rescue window, but greater room for subsequent布局"

text.content: "Chen Ji forcibly suppressed his restlessness, sitting cross-legged atop the mountain peak. The Tianji Record fragment slowly unfurled within his divine consciousness, and under the guidance of the word 'bridge,' those obscure runes gradually grew clear. He could sense that his connection to this heaven and earth was being reshaped in an unprecedented way."

dialogue.content: "'Young master's comprehension is remarkable.' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of gratification. 'The Bridge Way encompasses three realms—connection, bearing, and transcendence. Young master has now glimpsed the threshold, already capable of perceiving the subtle cracks between Heaven and humanity. This is the foundation of the third path.'"

text.content: "However, regardless of which path one chooses, there is an inescapable truth—Su Qingyao's kidnapping is by no means a simple clash between factions. While tracking, Chen Ji quietly divined using the Tianji Record fragment, and discovered a truth that made his spine crawl: Su Qingyao became a target because she is the sole person in the Tianqing Sect who has thrice come infinitely close to Chen Ji's secret."

dialogue.content: "From the depths of the void, a transcendent will fluctuation suddenly transmitted. It was the Heavenly Eye—manifesting so clearly in Chen Ji's perception for the first time. 'You are clever, Chen Ji.' That voice carried no emotion, no temperature, yet seemed to pierce all illusions, reaching directly into the depths of his soul. 'But the cleverer you are, the more suited you become for a bridge. A bridge needs two ends—and your guide is precisely the optimal anchor connecting you to Heaven.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji's expression instantly darkened to ink. The Heavenly Eye's words were like a basin of ice water poured over his head, making him abruptly realize a blind spot he had been overlooking: Su Qingyao was not merely someone he trusted, but the embodiment of the Tianqing Sect's fortune—and Tianqing was precisely the forbidden sect that had opposed Heaven and ultimately perished. She is the 'human end' of the bridge, and what the Heavenly Eye wants is not to destroy this bridge, but to control it utterly."

choice.prompt: "Faced with the Heavenly Eye's threats and implications, Chen Ji must decide: to comply with its arrangement and feign cooperation in exchange for Su Qingyao's safety, or to openly provoke and declare the third path's independence?"

choices.description: "Temporarily hold back and delay with an attitude of 'considering cooperation,' while secretly seeking Su Qingyao's true location and the enemy's weaknesses."
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain critical intelligence, see through enemy arrangements"
choices.risk_hint: "May be seen through by the Heavenly Eye, alerting the enemy instead"

text.content: "Chen Ji drew a deep breath, and an unhurried smile actually appeared on his face. 'The Heavenly Eye makes a valid point.' His voice was neither servile nor haughty. 'Since a bridge requires two ends, then Chen truly must understand—what is the extent of Heaven's 'sincerity' on this end.' That smile was gentle to the point of being insincere, save for the cold gleam that flickered and vanished in the depths of his eyes."

dialogue.content: "'An interesting response.' A hint of amusement actually appeared in the Heavenly Eye's will fluctuation. 'You think you are scheming, yet every step unfolds under my gaze. However... keeping you intact may be more valuable than destroying you.' Before the voice finished, a blurred image flooded into Chen Ji's mind—Su Qingyao trapped amidst ruins, surrounded by nine blood-red chains."

choices.description: "Enough of this! Directly counter the Heavenly Eye's will with the power of the Tianji Record, proclaiming the third path's independence, refusing to be anyone's chess piece."
choices.risk_hint: "May trigger the Heavenly Eye's direct annihilation"

text.content: "'The bridge is mine, the path is mine, the right to choose is also mine.' Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, the Tianji Record erupting in his palm with blinding golden radiance. 'If you Heavenly Dao want to use me, then show sufficient筹码; if you want to destroy me, then let's see if the ancient sage's will sealed within this fragment is enough for mutual destruction!' The words fell, heaven and earth changed color, and a magnificent momentum surged from within Chen Ji skyward."

dialogue.content: "'Very well.' The Heavenly Eye's voice反而calmed instead, that calm containing a more chilling pressure. 'Since you have chosen the most difficult path, let me see... how long can you and your guide hold out.' The next instant, that will receded like a tide, leaving only endless cold spreading through Chen Ji's heart."

text.content: "Regardless of Chen Ji's choice, the location of the Heavenly Dao Ruins has been clearly branded in his consciousness. That is the forbidden land left from the ancient era when Heaven and the mortal realm waged war; legend holds that not even the Heavenly Emperor could fully control its chaotic laws. And now, Su Qingyao is trapped there—or rather, someone intentionally placed her there, waiting for him to walk into the trap."

dialogue.content: "'Young master, though the Heavenly Dao Ruins bear the Heavenly Emperor's seals, they are not impassable.' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul manifested once more, his hand pointing virtually, and a precise topographic map unfolded before Chen Ji. 'The ruins consist of nine layers—the outer three are chaotic law zones, the middle three are consciousness erosion zones, and the inner three... there is sealed a portion of the Heavenly Emperor's origin. Your guide is trapped in the sixth layer—the core of the consciousness erosion zone.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji stared at that map, his mind racing. The sixth layer... that is precisely where consciousness erosion is most severe; ordinary people would lose their sanity after staying there for the time it takes to burn a stick of incense. And for Su Qingyao to endure there this long, either her cultivation is profound enough and her will resolute enough, or... 'Someone wants her alive and waiting for me.' Chen Ji murmured to himself. 'Because her presence can disrupt the Tianji Record's foresight—just like Chen Nian.'"

dialogue.content: "A terrible speculation crystallized in his heart: Su Qingyao and Chen Nian may themselves be two interrelated chess pieces in Heaven's arrangement. The former is the 'bridge anchor' connecting Chen Ji to Heaven, while the latter is the 'fate fog' disrupting the Tianji Record's foresight—and now, these two pieces are actually controlled by the same force. 'This is no coincidence.' Brilliant light blazed in Chen Ji's eyes. 'When Mother arranged her布局back then, she had already foreseen today.'"

choice.prompt: "Chen Ji is about to depart for the Heavenly Dao Ruins. In final preparations, he must decide which trump card to bring: Heavenly Fate reserves for emergencies, demonic path mist that can conceal aura, or a page of knowledge Mo Xiansheng is about to unseal?"

choices.description: "Heavenly Fate is fundamental to using the Tianji Record. Preserve sufficient Heavenly Fate reserves to ensure adequate foresight ability to handle unexpected situations within the ruins."

text.content: "Chen Ji closed his eyes in concentration, guiding the residual heavenly fate energy within his body to reconverge. Mo Xiansheng guarded beside him, murmuring incantations, and a pearl glimmering with ghostly blue light gradually formed in his palm. Though this pearl contained scattered Heavenly Fate, it was enough to sustain him for three breaths in the most critical moment."

dialogue.content: "'Three breaths... sufficient.' Chen Ji opened his eyes, securing the Heavenly Fate Pearl close to his body. Su Qingyao, wait for me. This time, he would not let anyone snatch away those who mattered."

choices.description: "Contact Ye Qing to borrow the demonic path mist's concealment ability, which can mask heavenly secrets fluctuations when using the Tianji Record, preventing enemy tracking."
choices.visible_reward: "Aura completely hidden when using Tianji Record"

text.content: "A secretive transmission pierced the void, and moments later, Ye Qing's voice sounded with a hint of languor: 'Oh, Young Master Chen finally remembers me?' Chen Ji briefly explained the situation; the other side fell silent for a moment. 'I can lend you the demonic path mist, but I want you to promise me one thing—when you find Chen Nian, bring her to the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path. I want to meet this person who can make you, the cold-hearted one, act recklessly.'"

dialogue.content: "'Deal.' Chen Ji did not hesitate for a moment. Su Qingyao's matter cannot be delayed; as for Chen Nian... that can be dealt with after the rescue. A wisp of jet-black mist seeped from the talisman, circling around Chen Ji before slowly merging into his aura. From this moment, his heavenly secrets fluctuations would completely vanish from this world—at least, on the surface."

choices.description: "Have Mo Xiansheng unseal a page of knowledge in advance, obtaining detailed intelligence on the Heavenly Dao Ruins and possible shortcuts, but at the cost of consuming Mo Xiansheng's already faint remnant soul power."
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain complete intelligence on Heavenly Dao Ruins"

text.content: "'Mo Xiansheng, my apologies.' Chen Ji's voice was low and sincere. Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, then suddenly let out an aged yet relieved laugh: 'Young master need not dwell on it. This wisp of remnant soul exists precisely for this moment.' With that, he formed seals with both hands, and the first page of the Tianji Record suddenly blazed with blinding white light. The next instant, a torrent of information rushed into Chen Ji's Mental Sea like a breached dam."

dialogue.content: "'The ninth layer of the Heavenly Dao Ruins seals a strand of the Heavenly Emperor's origin.' Mo Xiansheng's voice transmitted along with the information, though considerably weakened. 'If young master can find the 'Heavenly Emperor's Dying Tear' in the seventh layer, the ruins' erosion can be temporarily suppressed. Additionally, the sixth layer is not completely sealed—there exists a secret passage used by generations of grave keepers, leading directly to the seventh layer. However...' He paused. 'That passage requires Heavenly Fate to activate.'"

text.content: "With everything prepared, Chen Ji embarked on his journey to the Heavenly Dao Ruins. That place is where heaven and earth are closest to Heavenly Dao's origin, and also the forbidden land Chen Ji had never dared approach. But now, for Su Qingyao, for the third path, for those he must protect—he had no other choice. The entrance to the Heavenly Dao Ruins floated above the nine heavens, resembling a colossal eye, emanating a chilling pressure that stole one's breath."

"Just as Chen Ji was about to step into the ruins' entrance, the fourth page of the Tianji Record suddenly manifested, golden light coalescing into large characters: 'The way of the bridge begins beneath your feet—the first step, rescue your guide.' That radiance outshone any previous manifestation, as if endorsing his decision. At the same time, Chen Ji felt a slumbering power within him slowly awakening—the origin of 'the bridge' responding to his resolve."

"'Su Qingyao, I'm coming.' Chen Ji murmured, stepping into the ruins' entrance. In an instant, heaven spun and earth whirled; a chaotic whirlwind of laws enveloped him. Countless chaotic whispers assailed his ears, as if innumerable wandering souls were pouring out their grievances to him. Yet Chen Ji's will was unyielding as iron—his sole objective was the woman trapped in the sixth layer who had endured nine days. Within the ruins, a rescue operation determining the fate of the third path officially commenced."
